fish.inference: native 512 tiles, stride 384, mean overlapping logits then softmax

diver.inference: long edge 256, centered black letterbox, restored native logits, softmax

protection.seed: Union of fish and diver threshold masks; do not discard small connected components.
protection.margin: square dilation radius max(1, round(margin_at_1920 * max(width,height)/1920)); zero margin remains zero
protection.temporal: At most previous raw seed, without recursion or future frames; reset at each sequence and every static image. Hold may lag motion; evaluate it as a diagnostic, not guaranteed stability.
protection.soft_edge: After candidate selection, alpha=1 on hard protection, linear exterior feather width max(1,round(4*long_edge/1920)); keep the target core unchanged.
protection.fallback: Empty current union or hard protection >50% of frame disables background processing for that frame. Report fallback separately, never use its full-frame coverage to claim localization success.
